summary.text: Leo Delperdang is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 94 who has served since January 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An electrical engineer by training, he worked in telecommunications and at Koch Industries, and he is the only candidate listed for the seat in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Leo Delperdang was born in Sioux City, Iowa, and earned a degree in electrical engineering, a second degree in business and a master's degree from Newman University.
His career experience includes working with AT&T and Bell Laboratories and serving as Director of Voice, Data and Communications Infrastructures with Koch Industries.
He has been a member of the Kansas Patriot Guard.
Delperdang assumed office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2017.
